subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw own qwen-token-plan and runtime-only bailian-token-plan as qwen provider/auth/catalog compatibility contracts in this PR?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow bug fix; it creates new provider ids, setup/auth choices, an env var, endpoint hosts, catalog defaults, docs, and a legacy Bailian runtime owner that become product and compatibility commitments.

options.title: Accept bundled Token Plan contract
options.body: Land the qwen-token-plan provider plus runtime-only bailian-token-plan compatibility path after any needed branch refresh, treating these ids and auth/docs/catalog surfaces as supported.

options.title: Drop Bailian runtime ownership
options.body: Keep qwen-token-plan but remove or defer bailian-token-plan behavior until maintainers choose a separate Coding Plan/Bailian ownership contract.

options.title: Route outside bundled qwen
options.body: Pause or close this PR and ask for Token Plan support to ship as an external plugin or documentation-only custom-provider recipe.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Token Plan contract
recommendation.body: Land the qwen-token-plan provider plus runtime-only bailian-token-plan compatibility path after any needed branch refresh, treating these ids and auth/docs/catalog surfaces as supported.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this PR and has the strongest recent history on the qwen provider and provider endpoint/catalog surfaces touched here.
